purpose: Packaging application — specialty paper gift box design
prompt:
Packaging design photograph for 脸谱潮 LIANPU CHAO — specialty paper gift box and bag.

Scene: A premium gift box set on rice-paper #f5f0e8 background. The packaging design:
- OUTER BOX: Rectangular box (15x10x5cm) made of textured specialty paper in rice-paper #f5f0e8 color with visible paper fiber texture. The box lid features a hot-stamped gold #d4a843 foil deconstructed opera mask pattern — the gold catches light beautifully against the matte paper. Brand name 脸谱潮 is embossed in gold at the bottom.
- INNER TRAY: Black ink-black #1a1a2e molded pulp tray holding a single enamel pin in a velvet-lined slot. The contrast of the colorful pin against the black interior is dramatic.
- GIFT BAG: A small paper bag in rice-paper #f5f0e8 with cinnabar-red #e8433f rope handles, featuring a bold red and gold printed opera mask element on one side.
- TISSUE PAPER: Crumpled tissue in rice-paper tone with a repeating pattern of deconstructed mask elements printed in light gold.

The box is shown partially open to reveal the interior. The packaging communicates premium quality and cultural depth.

Style: Product photography, clean lighting, real material textures visible (paper fiber, foil stamping, embossing). Guochao aesthetic — bold graphic elements on refined materials. No text overlays.
